page.overview:
Who is Drizzle?

Drizzle is the placeholder name of a female background Pegasus pony with a pale purple coat, sandy yellow mane and tail, pink eyes, and a cutie mark of three purple umbrellas. She has a brief speaking role in The Ticket Master.

Drizzle shares her design and cutie mark with Parasol, Prim Posy, and "Downdraft", her design with Sassaflash, "Sandstorm", "Blue Diamond", "Snowslide", "Shocking Pink", "Cloud Showers", Honey Rays, "Bluebird Happiness", "Riverdance", "Wind Chill", "Blue Emerald", "Sky Flower", "Tiger Lily", "Cinnamon Swirl", S02E18 Unnamed Pegasus Mare #3, "Graceful Falls", S04E08 Unnamed Pegasus Mare #1, S04E13 Unnamed Pegasus Mare #1, S04E20 Unnamed Pegasus Mare #1, and normally "Flower Flight", her mane and tail style with "Chilly Puddle", "Purple Haze", "Welly", Green Jewel, and S05E24 Unnamed Earth Mare #3, and her mane style with "Chocolate Blueberry".

Her flower accessory is the same as the cutie mark of "Blossom Delight".

In The Best Night Ever, Drizzle appears as part of the singing choir during At the Gala.
